title: [Shopify] Link grouped invoice to all originating orders
summary: Invoice document linking to Shopify orders now correctly associates a single invoice with all originating Shopify orders when multiple shipments are grouped, instead of retaining filters from earlier shipments.
key_points: Clear stale Shopify document filters before resolving each shipment link
Grouped shipments from multiple orders are now linked to all originating orders
Added test coverage for grouped invoice scenario
Fixes issue where later shipment lookups were affected by retained filters from earlier shipments
quote: This clears those retained filters before each shipment lookup so the posted invoice is linked to every originating Shopify order.
